HardwareComponent.description: The HardwareComponent FRU schema defines the hardware properties of an HPM or of a component assembly such as a backplane or riser that are necessary to enable plug-and-play management of the component by a DC-SCM module attached to the HPM or to an HPM bearing the component.
HardwareComponent.specification: This resource shall represent the hardware properties of an HPM or of a component assembly such as a backplane or riser that are necessary to enable plug-and-play management of that component by a DC-SCM module attached to the HPM or to an HPM bearing the component.
